seconds_target: 作業 約4分／休憩 約5分半
budget: Suno 300クレジット以内・購入なし（本人10/27）
trial: まず各種1回（16曲・80見込み）で声・楽器・尺を確かめ、抜粋を本人が試聴してから残り20回（作業18・休憩2）

leads.name: ローズ（電気ピアノ）
leads.style: Warm Fender Rhodes electric piano in the foreground, soft mellow tone with only a gentle touch of tremolo, warm chords and a simple singing single-note melody, close and intimate. F major, 80 BPM. Instrumental study lo-fi hip hop for a calm late-autumn afternoon of studying at a wooden desk while low golden sunlight slowly fades toward evening. A relaxed steady boom-bap groove with a soft kick, a gentle snare and light swung hi-hats, a round warm bass and mellow jazzy chords underneath, gentle tape warmth. Calm, warm and focused, never sleepy, never dramatic. A long, continuous piece that keeps the same easy groove all the way through, with no breakdowns and no dramatic build. It continues in this same way for many minutes. About four minutes, gentle natural ending. No vocals, no humming, no whistling. No rain, no birds, no clock ticking, no field recordings. No dog sounds, no barking.
leads.exclude: vocals, singing, humming, whistling, chanting, spoken words, rap, vocal chops, rain, birds, crickets, clock ticking, city ambience, field recordings, dog sounds, barking, saxophone, acoustic grand piano, synth lead, electric guitar lead, trumpet lead, harpsichord lead, bass solo, melodica lead
